message:
Yen receipts now render correctly: a 500 JPY payment shows as `Paid ¥500 by card`. The full suite passes (18 of 18), including the yen receipt test.

`formatMoney` always divided by 100 and printed two decimals, so 500 yen came out as `¥5.00`. I fixed it in `src/utils/money.js` by adding a zero-decimal currency set (just `JPY`). Those currencies print the amount as-is.

`formatMoney` is shared with invoices, cart and admin, so JPY amounts there will now also show without decimals. I found no other JPY usage in the repo. If you add other zero-decimal currencies later, such as KRW, add them to that set.
